name: Meterpreter or Cobalt Strike Getsystem Service Installation - Security
description: Detects the use of getsystem Meterpreter/Cobalt Strike command by detecting a specific service installation
author: GAI_CTI
query: winlog.channel:Security AND (event.code:4697 AND (((winlog.event_data.ServiceFileName:*\/c* AND winlog.event_data.ServiceFileName:*echo* AND winlog.event_data.ServiceFileName:*\\pipe\\*) AND (winlog.event_data.ServiceFileName:(*cmd* OR *%COMSPEC%*))) OR (winlog.event_data.ServiceFileName:*rundll32* AND winlog.event_data.ServiceFileName:*.dll,a* AND winlog.event_data.ServiceFileName:*\/p\:*) OR winlog.event_data.ServiceFileName:\\\\127.0.0.1\\ADMIN$\\*))
